inputs.name: registerInfoCommand.program
inputs.description: Commander `Command` instance that receives this command registration. It must provide the `command`, `option`, `description`, and `action` methods used here; this function does not invoke the registered action.

outputs.name: registerInfoCommand
outputs.description: No value is returned. Calling this function attaches `info <topic>`, the `--json` option, the description, and an action to the supplied program; the action runs only when the command is invoked.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when `findGuide(topic)` returns no guide. The code calls `fail` with a message naming the unknown topic and listing the topics returned by `availableGuideTopics()`.
